modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Hand baggage over the 7 kg limit is charged at prevailing rates; up to 5 kg more can be bought, for a cabin total of no more than 12 kg.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One piece of hand baggage: 55 cm + 35 cm + 25 cm (L+W+H; total 115 cm) on Boeing flights, 50 cm + 35 cm + 23 cm (L+W+H; total 108 cm or 42.5 inches) on Q400 flights.

carryon_weight.value: Up to 7 kg, free of charge.

personal_item.value: A laptop bag, ladies' purse or duty-free shopping bag is allowed as long as the total cabin baggage stays within 7 kg.

infant.value: Passengers with infants can carry an extra piece of hand baggage up to 7 kg, within the same size limits.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Extra kilos can be pre-booked up to 03 hours before domestic departures and 06 hours before international departures, cheaper than airport rates.

allowance_domestic.value: Domestic flights: one free checked piece up to 15 kg, overall dimensions 158 cm (L+W+H).

allowance_international.value: International flights: two free checked pieces, with a weight allowance that depends on the sector.

max_piece.value: Passengers on the same PNR can pool checked baggage, but no single bag may exceed 32 kg.

prebook_domestic.value: Pre-booked extra baggage on domestic flights: 3 kg INR 1935 (USD 24), 5 kg INR 3225 (USD 39), 10 kg INR 6450 (USD 77), 15 kg INR 9675 (USD 115), 20 kg INR 12900 (USD 153), 30 kg INR 19350 (USD 228). Non-cancellable and non-refundable once bought.

phone_home_market.notes: Listed in the header of SpiceJet's own excess-baggage page.

conditions_of_carriage_url.notes: The excess-baggage page names this URL as SpiceJet's terms of carriage.
